subject: EU geographic pivot, APAC rollout timeline and one-time credit request
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emma Larson <emma.larson@vitalspan.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal planning: EU primary mirror + APAC staged rollout (timeline + ask)

Hi Emma —

Hope you had a great week. As VitalSpan’s renewal approaches (term end 2027-08-15) I wanted to confirm the outcome we discussed on the call last week: move EU to primary mirrored residency, and add an APAC warm-standby region for Q4 seeding.

To make the renewal clean for your procurement team we need: 
- a short SOW addendum that lists the EU mirroring timeline (proposed: staging July 15–Aug 10, cutover Aug 11–Aug 15)
- expected peak qps and avg token volume for the 30 day stabilization after cutover
- decision on whether APAC will be billed as burst-on-demand vs reserved pilot capacity (we recommended burst for the pilot)

We can offer a one-time contractual credit to offset your migration engineering costs if you confirm commit levels for the EU mirror (we discussed a 20% credit on first month of EU bill if VitalSpan moves to a 12-month renewal). I can share the SOW and pricing exhibit for procurement.

Attached: draft SOW (v3) and a short SOC2 summary per your security request.

Would Thursday or Friday work for a 30-min sign-off with procurement?

Thanks —
Tessa
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: VitalSpan_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW stub), SOC2_Summary_stub.pdf (report stub)

From: Emma Larson <emma.larson@vitalspan.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: VitalSpan Procurement <procurement@vitalspan.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: EU primary mirror + APAC staged rollout (timeline + ask)

Tessa —

Thanks for the note and the docs. A few quick items from procurement and my infra lead: 

1) Procurement needs an explicit billing model for APAC pilot (burst vs reserved) and an estimate of cost delta so we can budget.
2) Legal asked for a short clause on data locality during the 30-day stabilization window — can Redwood commit to EU-only primary processing for that period with audit logs?
3) On the credit: procurement will need a formal line item in the SOW describing the credit and showing pro-forma invoicing.

We can do Fri 09:30 BST for a short review — I’ll loop my infra lead if that’s helpful.

Best,
Emma
Director of Product, VitalSpan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: VitalSpan procurement asks — quick internal thread

Tessa / Aditya / Monica —

Forwarding Emma’s procurement points. Quick notes: 
- On APAC billing: recommend we propose "pilot burst" pricing for Q4 with cap opt-in (monthly cap threshold they can elect) and optional conversion to reserved at renewal. Ben suggests including an estimated delta row in the pricing exhibit.
- Data locality: our platform supports EU-primary processing and we can lock processing to EU for the 30-day stabilization window; Monica, please confirm required audit log retention for them (they asked for audit logs).
- Credit: I can approve a one-time migration credit up to 20% on first invoice if Aditya signs off on the commercial terms (we need to ensure margin).

Action items:
1) Monica to confirm audit log retention wording (and whether SOC2 summary suffices).
2) Aditya to provide final pricing delta line and credit approval note.
3) Tessa to update SOW with credit line item and APAC pilot billing model.

Thanks —
Ben
Director, Growth

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emma Larson <emma.larson@vitalspan.com>, VitalSpan Procurement <procurement@vitalspan.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 08:41:00 +0100
Subject: RE: Renewal planning: EU primary mirror + APAC staged rollout (timeline + ask)

Emma / team —

Appreciate the speedy feedback. Please see below and attached: an updated SOW addendum (v4) that includes the one-time credit line item and an APAC pilot billing exhibit with delta estimates.

Key points: 
- APAC pilot: default = burst-on-demand with an optional monthly cap they can elect. Example numbers are in the pricing exhibit (see proposed-pricing-exhibit.xlsx). If VitalSpan elects reserved capacity within 60 days of pilot start we will apply a conversion credit to the reserved commit (details in pricing).
- Data locality: Redwood will enforce EU-primary processing for all production traffic during the agreed 30-day stabilization window post-cutover (Aug 11–Sep 10). We will provide audit logs (retention: 90 days) and an export bundle for your audit team.
- One-time credit: 20% credit applied to the first invoice for EU mirror usage if VitalSpan signs a 12-month renewal by Aug 15. The SOW line item spells out mechanics for the credit.

Attachments: VitalSpan_Renewal_SOW_v4.pdf (SOW addendum), proposed-pricing-exhibit.xlsx
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123-vs-renewal

I’ll be on the Fri 09:30 BST call (joining from SF) — see you then.

Regards,
Tessa
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
